report:
Fresh final followup review of decisions. Saved/read the prior report and inputs, started fresh and recaptured all three dependencies. Every initial fragment (claim, three implementation files and three tests) is unchanged, as are fixture and reviewer checklist. The structural coverage dependency range now ends at 190 instead of 189 solely to include the added implementation_references association comment; comparison confirms no other difference. No decision behavior changed.

The full claim distinguishes completed acceptance (no requested edits), completed reports requiring work (nonempty edits), explicit justified TODO/N/A gaps, source-derived statuses without relabeling, all-entry reviewer assessment, and unfinished reviews which cannot pass. All three ordinary implementation entries remain sufficient. review::acceptable requires matching current inputs/versions, implementation and test associations, present valid nonblank output and an empty edit list. output_error rejects blank reviewer/report/edit strings. start removes prior completion, and record requires an active current snapshot before writing completed output. validate reports unfinished and requested-edit cases. Structural coverage independently checks both implementation and test inventories. The captured prompt/checklist require substantive all-aspect assessment and edits for unexplained gaps; semantic adequacy of prose remains reviewer judgment rather than a machine claim of proof.

Status is derived from associated source entries: evidence::placeholder_status maps enclosing TODO/N/A modules, excludes crate names and rejects conflicting ancestry. Inventory preserves status and explanation/source context; report acceptance cannot rewrite them. check_reviews keeps accepted TODO/N/A distinct from ordinary approval (TODO if any, N/A for all-N/A, otherwise ordinary), while individual evidence remains visible. The report schema has no separate decision/status override. The new dependency marker changes none of this.

All three ordinary tests were reassessed. accepted_placeholder_reports_preserve_todo_and_na_evidence exercises both modules, asserts test/implementation statuses and retained prerequisite explanation, records an honest deferral report, and requires a passing gate with zero ordinary approvals and the correct deferred/N/A count. invalid_reports_and_stale_inputs_never_complete_an_active_review rejects no-start and blank reports without output, rejects source mutation without rewriting inputs, then records concrete requested edits and verifies exact persisted output with failing gate and only the three allowed fields. start_invalidates_previous_success_and_record_is_required covers missing review, accepted review, restart clearing output/time, continued failure during reads, success only after record, preserved input bytes and refusal of duplicate record/postcompletion reads. The captured fixture invokes real review/check APIs, with direct assertions in tests. Fixture placeholders are test data; no TODO/N/A evidence or deferral exists for decisions itself.

All full-claim requirements remain supported after comparing the actual one-comment dependency delta against the prior complete assessment. No source edits, build or tests were performed; fresh review commands and source inspection only. No requested edits.
